form.label: Lab 01 - SSH Authentication Monitoring
form.description: SSH failures, brute-force sources and success-after-failure events from linux_secure. Import with Settings > User interface > Views, or paste into a new dashboard's Source view.

search.query: index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure ("Failed password" OR "Failed publickey" OR "Accepted password" OR "Accepted publickey") | rex "(?<outcome>Failed|Accepted) \S+ for" | timechart span=5m count by outcome

panel.title: Brute-force sources (failures per 1-minute bucket at or above threshold)

search.query: index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure ("Failed password" OR "Failed publickey" OR "Failed keyboard-interactive") | rex "Failed \S+ for (invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>\S+) port" | bin _time span=1m | stats count as failures dc(user) as distinct_users by _time host src_ip | where failures >= $threshold$ | stats max(failures) as peak_per_min sum(failures) as total_failures max(distinct_users) as max_users min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by host src_ip | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - total_failures
index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed" | rex "Failed \S+ for (invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from" | top limit=10 user

index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure ("Failed password" OR "Failed publickey" OR "Accepted password" OR "Accepted publickey") | rex "(?<outcome>Failed|Accepted) \S+ for (invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>\S+) port" | sort 0 _time | streamstats time_window=30m count(eval(outcome="Failed")) as recent_failures by src_ip | where outcome="Accepted" AND recent_failures >= $threshold$ | table _time host src_ip user recent_failures
